constraints: PodSecurityPolicy has no drop-in replacement: the admission controller was removed together with the API, so the policy must be re-expressed.
Decide the intended Pod Security Standard (privileged, baseline, or restricted) for each namespace the policy covered before changing anything.
Remove Roles and ClusterRoles that grant `use` on the PodSecurityPolicy once it is gone.

steps.instructions: Replace the PodSecurityPolicy with Pod Security Admission labels on the affected namespaces, or with a third-party admission webhook, as the Kubernetes migration guide describes.
steps.title: Choose a replacement policy

steps.instructions: Delete the PodSecurityPolicy manifest and any Role or ClusterRole rule that grants `use` on it.
steps.title: Remove references to the policy

verification.purpose: Preview which existing pods would violate the chosen Pod Security Standard, without changing any namespace.
Validate the remaining manifests against the target Kubernetes version.

rules.replacement: Pod Security Admission or a 3rd party admission webhook
rules.summary: The Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide states that the policy/v1beta1 API version of PodSecurityPolicy is no longer served as of v1.25, which was released on 2022-08-23.
rules.title: PodSecurityPolicy policy/v1beta1 is no longer served
